forest-ink.$description: Forest Ink — Hero canvas, primary heading text, nav bar surface, footer — the dominant dark that anchors every green-on-green moment

meadow.$description: Meadow — Primary action fill (GET FUNDING), accent headline words, tag fills — one switch-on green against both dark and cream surfaces

sage-border.$description: Sage Border — Muted green-gray for secondary borders, dividers on cream, subhead accents — lets Meadow read as the only chromatic action

lichen.$description: Lichen — Outlined/ghost action border, hover-state ring — a softer Meadow for non-filled interactive states

paper-cream.$description: Paper Cream — Main content canvas after the hero, card surface on dark hero, ghost-button fill — warm off-white that replaces typical SaaS white

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Body text on cream, hairline borders, image overlays — the workhorse neutral that keeps #122315 reserved for display moments

slate.$description: Slate — Icon strokes, near-black text, very dark UI fills when Forest Ink would be too green

frost.$description: Frost — Subtle dividers on cream, secondary card edges — quieter than Sage Border

moss-gray.$description: Moss Gray — Helper text, metadata, low-emphasis captions on cream

driftwood.$description: Driftwood — Dark borders and separators for elevated surfaces and inverted UI. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

river-blue.$description: River Blue — Illustration accent for water and sky in the hero artwork and badge illustrations, small data-viz highlight

sun-yellow.$description: Sun Yellow — Illustration accent for suns and warm callouts in the patch artwork, limited to decorative moments

deep-navy.$description: Deep Navy — Illustration dark fills, badge backgrounds where Forest Ink would blend with the canvas

deacon.$description: Display and headline family. The signature choice: an ultra-condensed sans scaled from 58px subheads up to 259px hero lines, with line-height compressed to 0.8 so two-line headlines read as a single block. Weight 900 for hero and section openers, 700 for mid-page headings, 400 for badge labels and small caps callouts. This is the only voice allowed to be loud.

graphik.$description: Body, UI, and small-text family. Weight 400 for paragraphs, captions, and nav; weight 500 for button labels, tag text, and emphasized subheads. The geometric humanist sans provides the quiet counterweight to Deacon's shouting display — every sentence is calm, every headline is compressed. Use at -0.4px tracking at 24px and above.

arial.$description: System fallback and chart/dashboard data labels where a neutral numeric voice is needed; 40px reserved for stat readouts in the dashboard preview
